notes: The update check works even on a network where the first server will not answer - it no longer says you are up to date while an update is waiting
A folder that only carries Minecraft's name is no longer called ready - the app says it is empty and keeps the set-up steps in front of you
The set-up list stays on screen until the game folder is really open; granting a permission no longer makes it disappear
A phone with no Minecraft is told exactly that, instead of being sent to install Shizuku
Full access is only shown for a folder that really holds your worlds and packs
A pack that has several builds is one row - open it to see every version and its size
